label: Text 2
transcript: A two-year trial of a four-day school week in a small Belgian district found test scores unchanged, pupil well-being scores higher, and modest cost savings. The trial included 14 schools, with a matched control group of 14 nearby schools. The results were peer-reviewed and published in 2027. The study notes one important limitation: many families struggled to arrange childcare for the extra Friday, and the burden fell unevenly on lower-income parents. The authors caution against scaling up before this is solved.
